column11: Anchor: Elahere's 2025 US starts of 4,142 = 0.3327 of the all-comers PROC cohort of 12,450. The derivation is on GSK's ovarian row: - US revenue: $607mm (2025), $538.8mm (2024, annualised). - Net price: $116,413 per patient-year. - Stock: 5,214 (2025) against 4,712 (2024), with 77.24% stopping. - In 2026 the rate is 0.3490 (Q2 x 4). Peak = 0.3327 x multiple 0.5 = 0.1663. The multiple is a JUDGEMENT. Case for a higher multiple: - Breakthrough designation (20 Jan 2026) after bevacizumab and mirvetuximab. - Activity at every FRalpha level: ORR 40% at 0-24% expression and 54% at 75% or more. - ORR 50% in 104 patients. - An all-comers label about 2.8 times Elahere's FRalpha-high label, and a head-to-head arm against chemotherapy or mirvetuximab. Case against: - Arrives about 2030 into a crowded class. - Genmab's Rina-S is also an FRalpha ADC for all comers and reads out about two years earlier (NCT06619236, 2027-02). - R-DXd PROC (2028-02, Breakthrough) and AZD5335 (2028-11) come first too. - FRAmework-01 excludes patients who had a prior topoisomerase-payload ADC. - Elahere is modelled off its own revenue, so share taken from it is counted twice. The multiple is set above GSK's 0.4 because Sofe-M reaches PROC about two years earlier and holds Breakthrough. Carryover: at 0, this drug's US revenue at year 10 is about $311mm; at the book default of 1.0 it is about $1.8bn, because the curve then converges on the whole cohort.
